decision_text: Approve the policy direction and strategic objectives of MIB 2.0 as the basis for further government design and validation
what_it_authorises: A common policy direction focused on removing structural barriers through needs-based delivery
what_it_does_not_authorise: Adoption of the six-year implementation portfolio; any ethnic entitlement; any expenditure or statutory change
completion_evidence: Cabinet decision records the approved direction and objectives

decision_text: Authorise a 90-calendar-day cross-agency validation exercise beginning on the date of Cabinet notification
what_it_authorises: Collection and reconciliation of the thirty validation items; agency data requests; legal, fiscal and delivery testing
what_it_does_not_authorise: Programme launch; beneficiary enrolment; grants; procurement; contracts; permanent establishment; or commitment beyond the validation period
responsible_owner: Prime Minister's Department with responsible ministries
completion_evidence: Validation report and disposition register submitted within 90 calendar days

decision_text: Establish an interim coordination arrangement and require participating ministries and agencies to nominate accountable focal points
what_it_authorises: A Prime Minister-sponsored oversight group, a senior-officials coordination mechanism and an interim secretariat operating within existing approved functions and resources
what_it_does_not_authorise: Creation of the proposed 35 permanent secretariat posts; transfer of statutory powers, budgets or accounting-officer responsibilities; direction of independent or state authorities
dependency: Existing lawful mandates and approved resources
completion_evidence: Terms of reference and named focal-point list issued

decision_text: Authorise preparation of a formal implementation submission after validation
what_it_authorises: Programme design sheets, a legal issues matrix, a Treasury-validated Phase 1 fiscal memorandum and an implementation decision paper
what_it_does_not_authorise: Automatic return to Cabinet with the current scope or figures; unresolved items must be removed, re-scoped or presented as explicit conditions
responsible_owner: Sponsoring minister and Prime Minister's Department
completion_evidence: Formal submission pack satisfies the Cabinet-ready test

decision_text: Require validation and design work to use existing approved resources unless a separate capped request is justified
what_it_authorises: Use of existing lawful administrative capacity for the validation exercise; preparation of a separately itemised request if a demonstrable resource gap remains
what_it_does_not_authorise: Any new design or validation appropriation under this proposal; use of the indicative six-year envelope; retrospective or open-ended expenditure
dependency: MOF concurrence for any later additional request
responsible_owner: Sponsoring ministry with Ministry of Finance
completion_evidence: Either written confirmation of delivery within existing resources or a separate itemised ceiling with Treasury concurrence

decision_text: Conditionally endorse the six-year architecture as the basis for validation and detailed design
what_it_authorises: Testing of the four-pillar, three-phase structure and its sequencing
what_it_does_not_authorise: Adoption of the architecture as a binding implementation plan or authority to proceed by calendar alone
dependency: Successful validation and later formal approval
responsible_owner: Prime Minister's Department with lead ministries
completion_evidence: Validated architecture included in the formal implementation submission

decision_text: Conditionally endorse the central fiscal scenario as an indicative planning case only
what_it_authorises: Treasury testing of programme costs, funding classifications, inflation treatment and affordability against conservative and expanded sensitivity cases
what_it_does_not_authorise: Approval of a final RM1,484.273 million envelope; confirmation of RM636.596 million as existing or reallocated funding; or any appropriation
dependency: Treasury validation and normal budget processes
responsible_owner: Ministry of Finance with Ministry of Economy
completion_evidence: Treasury-reviewed fiscal memorandum replaces the indicative scenario

decision_text: Conditionally endorse the sixteen retained substantive programme directions for detailed design
what_it_authorises: Preparation of programme design sheets and agency feasibility decisions
what_it_does_not_authorise: Approval, launch or funding of any individual programme; acceptance of provisional volumes or targets
dependency: Programme-specific legal fiscal mandate and baseline clearances
completion_evidence: Signed programme design sheet for each programme proposed for launch

decision_text: Conditionally endorse Phase 1 as a candidate implementation package for a later decision
what_it_authorises: Detailed scoping of a Phase 1 package and identification of the clearances applying to each component
what_it_does_not_authorise: Commencement of Phase 1; approval of its current RM355.3 million central scenario; or bypass of AGC, MOF, JPA, agency, state or partner decisions
dependency: Formal implementation submission and all applicable pre-launch gates
completion_evidence: Separate Cabinet decision identifies approved components, ceiling, owners and launch conditions

decision_text: Do not approve the final six-year fiscal envelope
what_it_authorises: Records the RM1,484.273 million central total solely as an indicative planning scenario
what_it_does_not_authorise: No financial ceiling, commitment or expectation of future appropriation is created
dependency: Treasury validation and later Cabinet decision
completion_evidence: Final amount appears only in a later Treasury-reviewed submission

decision_text: Do not approve or recognise unverified ministry reallocations as available funding
what_it_authorises: Permits ministries and Treasury to test whether any existing allocation can lawfully and operationally support the proposal
what_it_does_not_authorise: No ministry vote is surrendered, reserved, relabelled or reduced
responsible_owner: Ministry of Finance with affected ministries
completion_evidence: Written confirmation by vote programme and financial year

decision_text: Do not approve any Phase 1 appropriation or any Years 3–6 appropriation
what_it_authorises: Preserves later phase-by-phase decisions under the normal budget and development-planning processes
what_it_does_not_authorise: No present or future supply, development expenditure or rolling-plan allocation is authorised
dependency: Normal appropriation and Malaysia Plan processes
responsible_owner: Cabinet Parliament Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Economy
completion_evidence: Separate lawful approvals for each relevant phase and expenditure class

decision_text: Do not approve or direct PNB participation in PRG-11
what_it_authorises: Allows MOF to explore product options and seek PNB's independent commercial view
what_it_does_not_authorise: No commitment by PNB and no direction concerning a commercial product or allocation
dependency: PNB commercial agreement and MOF design approval
completion_evidence: Written product decision or an approved alternative qualifying provider

decision_text: Do not approve commitments dependent on states, local authorities, trustees or religious authorities
what_it_authorises: Allows consent-based engagement and mapping of applicable jurisdictional pathways
what_it_does_not_authorise: No state, land, housing, religious-institution, local-authority or trustee commitment is presumed
dependency: Written consent and applicable legal or administrative approval
completion_evidence: Documented consent or an explicit conditional exclusion from the launch package

decision_text: Do not approve programme outcome targets whose baselines are not verified
what_it_authorises: Allows baseline construction and testing of proposed target methodology
what_it_does_not_authorise: No to-be-established value or planning volume becomes a performance guarantee or entitlement
responsible_owner: Relevant data owner and lead ministry
completion_evidence: Published baseline methodology and approved recalibrated target

decision_text: Do not approve permanent-establishment, statutory, procurement or contractual consequences
what_it_authorises: Allows JPA, AGC, MOF and agencies to test the proposed delivery model
what_it_does_not_authorise: No 35-post secretariat, new legal power, procurement exercise, grant award, contract or beneficiary commitment is authorised
dependency: Applicable establishment, legal, fiscal and procurement approvals
responsible_owner: JPA, AGC, MOF and responsible accounting officers
completion_evidence: Each consequence is expressly authorised in a later instrument
